title: Kvarðinn rules component diagram
description: The pure rules: a Game, the actions that change it, and the view each device gets; plus the parser for the card file. Random numbers, who is online and the cards arrive through Ctx.

components.name: Kvarðinn rules
components.responsibility: The game, with no DOM, network, storage, clock or randomness of its own.

components.name: Game rules (game.ts)
components.responsibility: newGame, addPlayer and act(): seats, teams, host hand-over, settings, custom cards, the phase machine, turn order, scoring bands and the bonus guess; viewFor() hides tokens, the deck and, until the reveal, the target.

components.name: Card parser (cards.ts)
components.responsibility: parseCards(): one card per "Left ↔ Right" line (or <-> or |), skipping # comments, with the lines it could not read.

relationships.description: Returns the Card type game.ts declares.
